body: The key ring and scrub bucket are packed together. Brown foam from the pasture treatment has dried on both, with a high-water line of it inside the bucket.
title: hand shovel with a scrub bucket at on the cold night

body: A small receiver still set to an emergency band, a folded road map with the county roads crossed out in the same neat hand, and a strip of pills. The campers left before anyone announced a closure.
title: Receiver and map left at the cold camp
